title: A defect-rich carbon induced built-in interfacial electric field accelerating ion-conduction towards superior-stable solid-state batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05966B, Paper
Liyu Du, Yiming Zhang, Yiyang Xiao, Du Yuan, Meng Yao, Yun Zhang
The D-CSE with a built-in IEF is constructed via the introduction of defect-rich carbon due to the transference of electrons. The built-in IEF could facilitate the dissociation of alkali salts and build effective ion-transport channels.
